name: Victor J. Torres
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Maple Valley, Washington
about: Victor J. Torres is an attorney and partner at the law firm of Torres & Haroldson, PLLC, in Maple Valley, Washington. Mr. Torres focuses his practice on personal injury law and handles all types of catastrophic injury cases, including those involving car accidents, bicycle accidents, pedestrian accidents, slip and falls, and wrongful death. He represents clients in Maple Valley, Bellevue, Everett, Seattle, Tacoma and throughout the Puget Sound.

Mr. Torres has more than 10 years of experience. He enjoys sharing his legal knowledge with others, writing and speaking on various legal topics for groups, including the Washington State Association for Justice and the Washington Employment Lawyers Association. In addition, he volunteers his time to his community in south King County.

Active in his legal community, Mr. Torres maintains active membership in several organizations, including the King County Bar Association, the Tacoma-Pierce County Bar Association, the Washington State Bar Association, the Washington State Association for Justice, the Washington Employment Lawyers Association, the American Bar Association and the Northwest Indian Bar Association. He is also a founding member of the Filipino Lawyers of Washington.

Mr. Torres graduated from the University of San Francisco, where he majored in English and minored in accounting. He went on to graduate cum laude from Seattle University School of Law, serving as editor-in-chief of the Seattle University Law Review. He is qualified to practice before all Washington state courts, the U.S. District Courts for the Eastern and Western Districts of Washington, and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 9th Circuit.
